targets.rawSql:

WHERE ts >= now() AND ts <= now() + interval '48 hours'
ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), solar_irradiance_w_m2 AS "Actual (W/m²)"
FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND solar_irradiance_w_m2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, temp_south AS "South Temp" FROM climate WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, temp_east AS "East Temp" FROM climate WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, temp_west AS "West Temp" FROM climate WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS time,
    projected_temp_low::float AS "Compliant Low",
    projected_temp_high::float AS "Compliant High"
FROM fn_band_timeline($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo(), interval '30 minutes', 'vallery')
ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, solar_irradiance_w_m2 AS "Solar W/m²" FROM climate WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND solar_irradiance_w_m2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts

(SELECT ts AS time, solar_irradiance_w_m2 AS "Solar Forecast"
FROM climate WHERE solar_irradiance_w_m2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
(SELECT DISTINCT ON (date_trunc('hour', ts))
    date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, solar_w_m2 AS "Solar Forecast"
FROM weather_forecast WHERE ts > now() AND ts < now() + interval '72 hours'
ORDER BY date_trunc('hour', ts), fetched_at DESC)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cooling Equipment State
panels.description: Real-time fan, vent, and fog activity. Series are offset bands so cycling can be read against the same time axis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Fan 1" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='fan1' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS "Fan 2" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='fan2' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS "Vent" FROM (
  SELECT ts, state FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='vent' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
  UNION ALL
  -- seed: long-hold relays (vent stayed open 10h on 2026-07-12) have no
  -- transitions inside short windows; carry the state at window start
  SELECT $__timeFrom(), state FROM (
    SELECT state FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='vent' AND ts <= $__timeFrom()
    ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) seed
) x ORDER BY ts
SELECT $__time(ts), CASE WHEN state THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS "Fog" FROM equipment_state WHERE equipment='fog' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Cooling Runtime by Day
panels.description: Complete-day transition-derived cooling runtime for fans, vent, and fog.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz AS time, on_minutes AS "Fan 1 min" FROM mv_equipment_runtime_daily WHERE equipment='fan1' AND $__timeFilter((day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz AS time, on_minutes AS "Fan 2 min" FROM mv_equipment_runtime_daily WHERE equipment='fan2' AND $__timeFilter((day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz AS time, on_minutes AS "Vent min" FROM mv_equipment_runtime_daily WHERE equipment='vent' AND $__timeFilter((day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz) ORDER BY day

SELECT (day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz AS time, on_minutes AS "Fog min" FROM mv_equipment_runtime_daily WHERE equipment='fog' AND $__timeFilter((day::date + time '12:00')::timestamptz) ORDER BY day
